categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, including orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act, appointment of an arbitrator for dispute settlement, and revocation of previous orders. It focuses on statutory instruments and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister of Labour is incidental to the legal authority making the order, not the main focus of the gazette.
